sourceReference.provenance: Original EVA 03 runner generated using SAVEE 06/08/09 as optical style references. Full original provenance in work/eva-03-human-art.json.

findings: Lean adult runner with plausible proportions and a relaxed stride.
Separate singlet and shorts, shoes on both feet are visible.
Fine grain, soft luminous amber torso and lilac-blue edges remain present.
A little more clothing definition than the original was intentionally required by the brief.

qa.method: Inspected 16 source temporal samples and 8 processed samples with actual pixels, including first and last playable frames. Parent checks live browser playback.
findings: Natural alternating forward strides, reciprocal arm/leg action visible across sampled frames.
Full body retained and framing centered; no observed camera pan or zoom.
Background stays deep charcoal, with no new floor/environment.
Functional singlet, running shorts, shoes and amber/lilac color treatment persist.
Corrective optical defocus/grain removes the sharply resolved face/clothing produced by the video model in its middle frames.
The boundary returns to a closely matching stride and composition; no crossfade was required based on sampled frames.

technicalSeamEvidence.note: A technical comparison only; it is not a guarantee of perceptual seam invisibility.

limitations: The baked blur is consistent in application; the starting still is inherently softer than the synthesized middle, so softness is not pixel-identical across frames.
The optical movement trail is visible behind the primary runner.
